metadata.case_name: CHAN LEUNG SING v. NG KEUNG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Worked primarily as a welder and occasionally as a vault‑ceiling worker
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: security guard or gas station worker

injuries.description: multiple soft tissue injuries to the right knee
source: (1) The plaintiff suffered multiple soft tissue injuries to the right knee, right ankle and low back.

(13) “Apportionment: Dr Lam opines that from the evidences available, it is likely that Mr. Chan suffered from considerable and rather severe soft tissue injury to his right knee, triggering symptoms in the otherwise asymptomatic right knee degenerative arthritis, causing persistent pain and disability in the right knee. ... For the sake of apportionment, based on the evidences available, my estimation is that the subject accident and the pre-existing degeneration should each contribute about 50% to the present impairment and disability in the right knee.”
(8) At the time of the examination, the plaintiff’s right knee and right ankle injuries have reached maximal medical improvement.
(12) For the purpose of Employees Compensation, the plaintiff’s right knee condition should carry 10% loss of earning capacity

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the right ankle
source: (1) The plaintiff suffered multiple soft tissue injuries to the right knee, right ankle and low back.
(11) Residual pain in right ankle should be mild and estimated to carry 0.5% whole person impairment.
(8) At the time of the examination, the plaintiff’s right knee and right ankle injuries have reached maximal medical improvement.
(12) For the purpose of Employees Compensation, the plaintiff’s right knee condition should carry 10% loss of earning capacity and right ankle injury should carry 1% loss of earning capacity.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of ankle, unspecified

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to the low back
source: (1) The plaintiff suffered multiple soft tissue injuries to the right knee, right ankle and low back.
(2) It was likely that injury to the low back was mild and he had achieved satisfactory recovery from the injury.
(7) Medical treatment received by the plaintiff was appropriate. Surgery was not required.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

source: (5) It was likely that the plaintiff would have some degenerative changes in both knees before the subject accident though such degenerative changes were rather asymptomatic before the subject accident. Such degenerative changes were more severe in the right knee.

(13) Apportionment: ... considering the degree of degenerative changes in both knees, and considering Mr. Chan’s subsequent development of evidence of left knee (the uninjured knee) symptomatic arthritis as well, I would expect Mr. Chan should be able to enjoy rather painless function in his right knee for about 3-5 years. ... my estimation is that the subject accident and the pre-existing degeneration should each contribute about 50% to the present impairment and disability in the right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the knee or lower leg

injuries.description: right shoulder injury (if present, likely mild)
source: (4) Though the plaintiff complained of discomfort in the right shoulder, any right shoulder injury (if indeed present) was likely to be mild and the plaintiff had achieved satisfactory recovery. Significant residual impairment or disability of the right shoulder was unlikely.
